behavior: The application waits for a Google connectivity check, gathers OS/user/host/hardware/environment fields and encodes the profile in a GET to the matching external-IP PHP endpoint.
The empty mirror URL fails and the runtime falls back to server_url. Its appended profile produces duplicate data query parameters: data=&data=<base64 profile>.

An archive instruction extracts server-supplied bytes and executes supported EXE, PowerShell, BAT and MSI files from the output directory.
link subcommands pscmd, psevcmd and mpref respectively dispatch PowerShell commands, request elevation with -Verb runas, and request Defender exclusion paths.
TLS verification is disabled. A hardcoded username blacklist triggers an allocation loop in source. That allocation branch was reviewed statically and not replayed.

limits: All external dependencies and host effects were replaced by inert synthetic objects inside QuickJS with no Python callbacks. No real network, filesystem, child process, UAC interaction or Defender change occurred.
